text:
carol: Quick question — compliance asked for a continuous audit stream that ties config changes back to humans. Our existing change events only have service_account_id and raw config blobs. Do we have a plan to surface a stable human identity in exports?

ashwin: We talked about this briefly. Current hurdle: some changes happen from CI (service accounts), some from UI sessions. We can augment events with an `actor` field but need rules for mapping service_account -> user (if any). :thinking:

mira: We should avoid leaking PII. Proposal: include `actor` as {"id":"actor:<hash>", "type":"user|service|automation", "display":"alice@example.com"} where `display` can be redacted per compliance mode. For CI runs we put type=automation and display=null.

samir: Two small priorities: 1) deterministic sampling for noisy events (autoscale/routing heartbeats) — use hash(policy_id + day) so exports are reproducible; 2) keep a stable human-facing alias for dashboards, e.g., `actor_alias` = short name (alice.r) vs full email only in secured exports.

carol: Good. How would a single exported line look? Need something our security team can inspect quickly.

ashwin: Example (one-line JSON in stream):
```
{
  "ts":"1976543210",
  "event_type":"route.update",
  "resource":"route:k-89f",
  "actor":{"id":"user:U12345","type":"user","alias":"mira"},
  "change":{"before":"{...}","after":"{...}"},
  "retention_bucket":"90d",
  "sampling":false
}
```

mira: Notes: - `change.before` should be a trimmed snapshot not full blob for huge routes. - We need a `change.diff_id` linking to a blob store for full diffs (on-demand). - For exports that go to S3 we can choose redaction level: minimal (alias only), medium (email hashed), full (email plaintext for vetted enterprise exports).

eva: For the console UX: show `actor_alias` in the timeline and add a hover that resolves to a link to the identity profile (if allowed). Also show a badge when the actor was a service/automation.

samir: Quotas: on-demand export API needs a soft quota per org (e.g., 5 concurrent exports) and a token-based rate limit. We'll also need a cost-estimate header in the response for huge ranges.

ashwin: One more policy callout: retention + export obligations for EU customers — default `retention_bucket` must reflect tenant policy. Exports should include `data_region` and `legal_basis` fields when applicable.

carol: Implementation step idea: add `actor_resolution` table in our DB that maps service_account -> last_active_user and resolution_ttl=30d. If unresolved then mark `actor.type=service`. Anyone object?

mira: fine with that, but add audit trail for the resolution itself (who/what created the mapping).

ops-bot: Note: export job #458 created by mira at 1976543240. S3 presigned URL expires in 24h. :white_check_mark:

carol: OK I'll draft a tiny design doc outlining fields, sampling rules, and redaction modes. Assigning to @mira for the first pass — please also list the API surface for on-demand vs scheduled exports.

mira: On it. I'll post a link to the doc here when ready.

ashwin: FYI I'll open a small spike to verify deterministic sampling across shards this week.

carol: Thanks all, this helps.
